Title: [DASH-01] Fleet total is shown for the whole fleet
Preconditions: Standard seed data, fresh state. Web: POST /__admin/reset then reload. iOS: relaunch with -dcota-skip-onboarding YES.
Steps:
1. Prepare the data as described in the Setup column (S-STD = reset to standard data).
2. Open the app. Web: go to http://localhost:8080 in your browser. iOS: launch MockDCOTA in the simulator.
3. Make sure the Dashboard tab is selected (it is the first tab; on iOS its title is 'Fleet').
4. Wait until the loading spinner disappears and the tiles appear.
5. Find the tile labelled 'Total devices' and read the number.
Expected Result: Total devices tile reads 1,400,000.

Title: [DASH-07] Server error shows banner and Retry recovers
Preconditions: All API calls fail (503). Web: POST /__admin/scenario {"mode":"error"}. iOS: -dcota-scenario error.
Steps:
1. Set the backend to the error scenario (S-ERR) before opening the app.
2. Open the app. Web: go to http://localhost:8080 in your browser. iOS: launch MockDCOTA in the simulator.
3. Wait for the Dashboard to finish loading.
4. Look at the screen for a red banner and a Retry button.
5. Set the backend back to standard. Web: run curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"mode":"standard"}' http://localhost:8080/__admin/scenario. iOS: stop the app and relaunch it without the error launch argument.
6. Press Retry (iOS: pull down on the screen to refresh instead) and check the tiles load and the banner disappears.
Expected Result: Red error banner with the service-unavailable message and a Retry button. After the backend recovers, Retry loads the tiles and the banner goes away.
